about: Recipe the deploy ships that no list row holds: linking each person to every recording, time and place where their voice was heard or face seen (tools/know-who-is-in-this).

payload.label: Keep who appeared in a recording
payload.job: Hear and see who is in one recording from the voices and faces people enrolled with consent, and keep every stretch as a row linked to that person, the recording, the seconds and the place, so each person's list of recordings builds up and every recording knows who is in it. A voice nobody enrolled keeps its number; when that voice is enrolled later, running this again names every stretch of it.

file.description: The recording in this account by its content identity

recording_name.description: What the recording is called, as the person's files name it

listening.description: The listening the recording belongs to, so an unknown voice keeps its number across its recordings

look_for.description: What to look for; left out, both a voice and, for a picture or video, a face

every_seconds.description: For a video, how often a picture is taken to look for faces

place.description: Where the recording was made, when it is known; never guessed from the file's name

recorded_on.description: The day it was recorded, when it is known

people.description: A person's id in the prints mapped to that person's own row in the person's lists, list-id/row-id

source.from: what the owner commissioned on 2026-10-04: voice and face recognition that gives every person a growing web of every recording where they were heard or seen
source.note: Runs tool:who-is-in-this and tool:find-faces, which change no file, and keeps what they answered with tool:keep-who-appeared. Nothing is named who has not enrolled with consent words.

steps.title: Hear who spoke
steps.do: Skip this step and submit an empty speakers list when look_for is given and leaves out voice. Otherwise find the recording's earlier results first: when its transcript has heard_whole true, pass its timed stretches as segments; when it has none, leave segments out so the tool hears the recording itself. Run tool:who-is-in-this with file, listening and those segments, and submit its speakers and voices_heard exactly as it answered, naming nobody it did not name. A failure or a recording with no speech is submitted as it is, never as a guess.

speakers.description: The speakers array of the tool's answer, unchanged

checks.says: The tool that names voices exists

steps.title: See who is on screen
steps.do: Skip this step and submit an empty faces list when look_for is given and leaves out face, or when the recording is audio only. Otherwise run tool:find-faces with file and every_seconds, and submit its faces exactly as it answered together with the every_seconds it used (2 when none was given). A face it did not name stays unnamed.

faces.description: The faces array of the tool's answer, unchanged

checks.says: The tool that names faces exists

steps.title: Keep each stretch as a row linked to the person
steps.do: Run tool:keep-who-appeared with recording set to input.file, recording_name, heard set to the speakers of step hear when it has any, seen set to the faces of step see when it has any (with every_seconds), and listening, people, place and recorded_on from the input. Leave out heard and seen when their lists are empty, and give at least one. Submit its answer exactly. A refusal for missing consent is submitted as the refusal: nothing is linked to a person whose print is gone.

checks.says: The tool that keeps appearances exists

steps.title: Read the rows back by recording
steps.do: Run tool:where-someone-appeared with recording set to input.file, and submit every row id it returns as list-id/row-id and the people and recordings it counted. Every row the keep step kept must be among them; a row missing here was not kept.

row_ids.description: list-id/row-id of every row the read returned

people.description: The people it counted, each with their id, label and number of rows

checks.says: The tool that reads appearances exists
Every row kept is read back
